condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I. B.1. No later than one month after the Effective Date, the Recipient, through the MHCP, shall prepare andadopt an operations manual (“Operational and Vaccine Delivery and Distribution Manual” or “OVDDM”).

Schedule 2; Section I, A.1. Institutional Arrangements. Without limitation to the provisions of Section 3.01, the Recipient,through the MHCP, and with the assistance of UNOPS, shall carry out the Project in accordance with this Agreement, theImplementation Agreement and the Project Operations Manual, and for this purpose, the Recipient, through the MHCP, shall maintainthroughout Project implementation a Project Management Unit (“PMU”) with a structure, staff, functions, responsibilities andadequate resources as set forth in the Project Operations Manual, all acceptable to the Association.

Schedule 2; Section I, A.1. Institutional Arrangements. 1. The Recipient, through the MHCP, shall be responsible for the overallimplementation of the Project, and for this purpose shall maintain throughout Project implementation a Project Management Unit(“PMU”) with a structure, staff, functions, responsibilities and adequate resources as set forth in the Operational and VaccineDelivery and Distribution Manual, acceptable to the Association.

Schedule 2; Section I, C1. Project Operations Manual. No later than one month after the Effective Date, the Recipient, throughthe MHCP, shall prepare, adopt and thereafter, carry out, the Project in accordance with an operations manual (“Project OperationsManual”), which shall contain detailed work flow, methods and procedures for the implementation of the Project, including but notlimited to: (i) administration and coordination arrangements, including placement of necessary and qualified human resources forProject implementation; (ii) performance indicators of the Project; (iii) monitoring and evaluation; (iv) financial managementguidelines and procedures; (v) anti-corruption and fraud measures; (vi) roles and responsibilities of various agencies andstakeholders in the implementation of the Project; (vii) list of goods eligible to be purchased under the Project (“EligibleGoods”); and (viii) list of eligible facilities to receive Eligible Goods under the Project selected in accordance with SectionB.1(a)(ii) of this Schedule (“Eligible Facilities”).

title.narrative: Selected health facilities with essential medical and laboratory supplies and equipment procured and delivered by the Project.
Plan for the procurement and distribution of essential medical and laboratory supplies and equipment to the health facilities completed and updated.
Submission of quarterly progress reports to the GoN and the WB in a format to be agreed with the WB.
Health storage facilities equipped with energy-efficient storage areas to store temperature sensitive samples and medical supplies.
Health facilities with waste management plans including residual water management under implementation.
Population receiving a booster, which is included in the population targets defined in the NVDP.
Health facilities that support female health care workers with stress management techniques and mental health tools for self-care.
Women 30-49 years old diagnosed with cervical cancer undergoing treatment.
Stakeholder engagement meetings held to discuss stakeholder inputs regarding project implementation and summary of agreed actions to address stakeholders' inputs.
Population fully vaccinated which is included in the priority population targets as defined in the NVDP disaggregated by sex and location.
